detection.title: Game Recording & Overrides
detection.description: Games you record show up here automatically. Pick one to change its recording settings or whether it gets recorded. Add a game below only if Segra doesn't record it on its own.

autoRecord.label: Auto-Record Games
autoRecord.description: Automatically start recording when a game launches. Games set to Always and manual recordings are unaffected.

addGame.label: Add a Game
addGame.placeholder: Search for a game to record...
addGame.noMatch: No matching game in the catalog.

detection.empty: No games yet. Games you record show up here, or search for one above.

removeConfirm.title: Remove game settings?
removeConfirm.description: Remove {{name}} and all of its recording overrides? Existing recordings will not be deleted.

automaticRecording.title: Automatic Recording
automaticRecording.description: Whether Segra starts recording when this game launches. Auto-Record Games is currently {{state}}.

quality.title: Recording Quality
quality.description: Override resolution, frame rate and bitrate for this game.

mode.title: Recording Mode
mode.description: Override whether this game records a full session, a replay buffer, or both.

discardBookmarks.title: Discard Sessions Without Bookmarks
discardBookmarks.description: Override whether sessions of this game are discarded when they have no manual bookmarks.
discardBookmarks.checkbox: Discard Session Recordings Without Manual Bookmarks

hdr.title: HDR Recording
hdr.description: Override whether HDR recording is enabled for this game (e.g. disable it for games where HDR injection tools break capture).
hdr.checkbox: Record in HDR when the display supports it

volume.title: Recording Volume
volume.description: Override the captured game/system audio volume for this game, without changing your own in-game or Windows volume.

highlightPadding.title: Highlight Padding
highlightPadding.description: Override how many seconds are kept before and after each highlight moment in this game.

integrations.title: Game Integrations
integrations.description: Enable automatic event detection for supported games. When enabled, Segra will automatically bookmark kills, goals, and other events during gameplay.

notes.overwatchColorBlind: Kills and assists only work with color blind mode off.

custom.title: Add Custom Game
custom.description: For games Segra doesn't detect on its own. It records the game whenever one of these executables runs.
custom.catalogMatch: Matches {{name}} in Segra's game list, so it gets that game's icon and cover.

removeExecutable.title: Remove executable?
removeExecutable.description: Remove this executable from the custom game?

picker.noApps: No apps running. Start the game, then press Refresh.
